testsuite.name: NotificationProcessorScheduler

testcase.name: processOutbox should mark notification as FAILED when max attempts reached
processOutbox should mark notification as FAILED when recipient user not found
processOutbox should process multiple notifications independently
processOutbox should send email and mark notification as SENT on success
processOutbox should increment attempt and schedule retry on email failure
processOutbox should do nothing when no pending notifications exist
